resources.string: Notices when you open the system screen for removing Shield, so it can ask for your guardian PIN first. It does not read screen contents, collect anything, or send it anywhere.
Removing Shield takes protection away at exactly the moment you asked for it. Enter your guardian PIN to continue.
That PIN did not match. Try again.
Notices when the uninstall guard needs your attention.

Shield noticed your uninstall guard is switched off, so removing Shield is currently unguarded. Some devices turn the service off after an update or reboot. Open Accessibility settings to turn "Shield uninstall guard" back on.
